name: repair-operations
description: Shared CMS provider search with Agent-owned estimate, availability, and booking operations

inlinePayload.name: get_repair_options
inlinePayload.description: Find exactly three repair providers from the shared CMS table, prioritizing the requested district, and calculate a reference estimate from Agent-owned price history.

issue_type.description: Normalized issue type such as plumbing_leak

city.description: Service city, for example 台北市

district.description: Service district, for example 信義區

inlinePayload.name: create_repair_booking
inlinePayload.description: Create an idempotent repair booking request after the user explicitly selects a provider and an available slot.

task_id.description: Stable idempotency key for this repair task

slot_id.description: Available slot selected by the user

issue_summary.description: Concise repair description stored with the booking

estimate_low.description: Reference estimate lower bound in TWD

estimate_high.description: Reference estimate upper bound in TWD
